name: Chirimiri Municipal Corporation
headquarters: Office of Nagar Nigam Chirimiri, Manendragarh-Chirmiri-Bharatpur, Chhattisgarh 497449
description: The district lists Chirimiri, also spelled Chirmiri, as a municipal corporation distinct from Manendragarh Municipal Council. Chirimiri had 40 wards in the 2025 municipal election. City Finance identifies it by Census 2011 town code 801916 and records a 2011 population of 85,317.
